title: Port Fixtures
author: theasianpianist
body:
Fixtures to retrieve port info for a test run:

1. The ToR interface name that we are using for testing
2. The PTF interface connected to the ToR interface from (1).
3. The upper ToR interface name connected to a selected T1, and the corresponding PTF port
4. The lower ToR interface name connected to the same T1 as (3) and the corresponding PTF port
